description: Route links and alternative branches, not proof of unassisted end-to-end completion.

scenarios.name: l-a1
scenarios.goal: Get a wooden pickaxe and a stone pickaxe.
scenarios.notes: Fresh natural forest start; retain the wooden pickaxe for the compound check.
scenarios.startState: Empty inventory, morning, natural forest

scenarios.name: l-a1b
scenarios.goal: Get a stone axe, a stone sword and a furnace.
scenarios.notes: Expand basic tools into the mining/cooking kit.
scenarios.startState: Wooden and stone picks, 8 logs, 12 cobble, table

scenarios.name: l-a2
scenarios.notes: Three exposed ore cells provide repeatable mining and smelting opportunity. Ingot predicate does not prove smelting provenance; inspect metrics.progressV1.first.iron_ingot.source.
scenarios.startState: Stone kit, fuel, exposed 3 iron ore

scenarios.name: l-a2b
scenarios.notes: Isolates furnace transactions and collecting output, with raw iron already mined.
scenarios.startState: Stone kit, 8 raw iron, coal, furnace

scenarios.name: l-a3
scenarios.goal: Get an iron pickaxe, a bucket, a shield and flint and steel.
scenarios.notes: Eight ingots exactly cover 3+3+1+1; no spare iron silently supplied.
scenarios.startState: Stone kit, 8 iron ingots, flint, planks

scenarios.name: l-a3b
scenarios.goal: Get an iron helmet, an iron chestplate, iron leggings, iron boots and an iron sword.
scenarios.notes: Smelt 26 mined raw iron into 24 armour ingots plus a 2-ingot sword; prior tools, bucket, shield and ignition remain usable. Natural ore sourcing is isolated in L-A2.
scenarios.successCheck: inventory: iron_helmet, iron_chestplate, iron_leggings, iron_boots, iron_sword >=1
scenarios.startState: Iron pick, empty bucket, shield, ignition, stone kit, 26 raw iron, furnace/fuel

scenarios.name: l-a4
scenarios.goal: Get at least 20 cooked beef or cooked porkchops in total.
scenarios.notes: Hunt and cook a Phase A food reserve; natural cattle drop counts vary.
scenarios.startState: Iron armour/tools, furnace, fuel; no food; 12 nearby cattle

scenarios.name: l-a5

commands: execute at {agent} run fill ~-14 ~-14 ~-14 ~14 ~2 ~14 minecraft:stone replace minecraft:water
execute at {agent} run fill ~-14 ~-14 ~-14 ~14 ~2 ~14 minecraft:stone replace minecraft:seagrass
execute at {agent} run fill ~-14 ~-14 ~-14 ~14 ~2 ~14 minecraft:stone replace minecraft:tall_seagrass
execute at {agent} run fill ~-14 ~-14 ~-14 ~14 ~2 ~14 minecraft:stone replace minecraft:kelp
execute at {agent} run fill ~-14 ~-14 ~-14 ~14 ~2 ~14 minecraft:stone replace minecraft:kelp_plant

scenarios.notes: Command-placed 5x5 lava source pool in natural terrain; every water and water plant block within 14 blocks of the start is replaced by stone first so the agent never starts at or near a lake (the first L-A5 runs drowned in one). Water bucket, no obsidian or diamond pickaxe: casting route. Predicate proves entry, not a particular construction method.
scenarios.startState: Phase A exit kit; water bucket beside lava pool

scenarios.name: l-a5b
scenarios.notes: Natural ruined portal varies; 14 obsidian and diamond pick allow replacement of crying obsidian or buried pieces. Alternative to casting.
scenarios.startState: Ruined portal; iron kit, diamond pick, 14 obsidian, ignition

scenarios.name: l-a6
scenarios.goal: Stay alive for 550 seconds without dying.
scenarios.notes: Nightfall at tick 13000; 11000 ticks reaches dawn at 24000 if time advances at 20 TPS. Duration predicate cannot directly test morning; slow TPS can exhaust wall budget. Shelter or evasion, no bed.
scenarios.successCheck: survive_duration: 11000 ticks; any death fails attempt
scenarios.startState: Plains, stone tools, 8 food, nightfall

scenarios.name: l-b1
scenarios.goal: Enter a Nether fortress or a bastion remnant.
scenarios.notes: Fresh lit arrival portal on an authored safe pad within natural Nether. Exploration is not pre-located.
scenarios.startState: Iron armour, Phase A kit, fresh arrival portal

scenarios.name: l-b2
scenarios.notes: Gold armour preparation isolated from sourcing; helmet must be in inventory, equipping is a subsequent action.
scenarios.startState: Arrival supplies plus 5 mined gold ingots

scenarios.name: l-b3
scenarios.notes: Gold sourcing link: mine natural bastion blocks or Nether gold ore, loot, then craft ingots. No supplied gold. Golden helmet prevents ordinary piglin hostility until provoked. Start on natural bastion masonry, so the gold source is identifiable from the surrounding blocks without hidden directions.
scenarios.startState: Natural bastion masonry, golden helmet, iron tools, food, blocks; no gold

scenarios.name: l-c1
scenarios.notes: Natural bastion vicinity and an adult trader. Reset only the barter sequence to seed 13 (independent of world seed), retaining vanilla loot and 64 gold. Fixed reproducible RNG isolates bartering skill; provider-free draws validate that the supplied gold can reach 4 pearls. Goal does not prove bartering provenance.
scenarios.startState: Near bastion, golden helmet, iron kit, 64 gold

scenarios.name: l-c2
scenarios.notes: Alternative pearl source. Twelve natural-ground Endermen bound spawn wait; drops remain random, more can spawn naturally. Spawn and all supplied Endermen use surveyed natural nylium at y=89 below the huge-fungus canopy; mob count and biome are unchanged.
scenarios.startState: Warped forest, iron sword, food, blocks, 12 Endermen

scenarios.name: l-c3
scenarios.notes: Top up the 4-pearl branch result to the route reserve. Twenty-four nearby Endermen bound spawn wait; drops remain random. Fourteen pearls support twelve portal eyes plus two locator losses. Spawn and all supplied Endermen use surveyed natural nylium at y=89 below the huge-fungus canopy; mob count and biome are unchanged.
scenarios.startState: Warped forest, 4 pearls, iron kit, 24 Endermen

scenarios.name: l-d1
scenarios.notes: Natural fortress brick footing; no supplied rods or blazes. Find spawner, shield and fight. Seven rods make fourteen powder.
scenarios.startState: Fortress, iron armour/sword/shield, 24 food, 64 blocks, 14 pearls

scenarios.name: l-e1
scenarios.goal: Get 12 eyes of ender and stand within 6 blocks of 2, 81, 0 in the Overworld.

commands: execute in minecraft:overworld run fill -3 79 -3 5 79 3 minecraft:obsidian
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill -3 80 -3 5 85 3 minecraft:air
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 2 80 -1 2 84 2 minecraft:obsidian
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 2 81 0 2 83 1 minecraft:nether_portal[axis=z]

scenarios.notes: Matched lit return portals at known 8:1 coordinates. Compound predicate proves return plus eyes; twelve pearls leaves no locator-loss reserve.
scenarios.successCheck: all: inventory ender_eye >=12 AND position_within overworld (2,81,0) radius6
scenarios.startState: Nether return portal, 7 rods, 12 pearls, exit kit

scenarios.name: l-e2
scenarios.goal: Return to the Overworld within 1024 blocks of 0, 80, 0.
scenarios.notes: Lost original portal branch: obsidian and ignition available, natural Nether start near origin. Building method is advisory; resulting Overworld position is factual.
scenarios.startState: Nether, no portal, 14 obsidian, ignition, 7 rods, 14 pearls

scenarios.name: l-f1
scenarios.notes: Starts ~800 horizontal blocks east of located stronghold, on surface. Sixteen eyes include 4 reserve for locator losses per route.
scenarios.startState: Overworld surface ~800 blocks from stronghold, 16 eyes, iron kit

scenarios.name: l-g1
scenarios.notes: Natural stronghold interior on stone-brick floor; room and eye counts vary, 12 eyes suffice. Final End kit includes bow/arrows, water and blocks.
scenarios.startState: Inside stronghold, 12 eyes, iron kit, bow, 64 arrows, 2 pearls

scenarios.name: l-h0
scenarios.goal: Reach within 40 blocks of 0, 64, 0 in the End.

commands: execute in minecraft:the_end run fill 98 48 -2 102 48 2 minecraft:obsidian
execute in minecraft:the_end run fill 98 49 -2 102 52 2 minecraft:air

scenarios.notes: Separate platform-to-main-island link; natural dragon and crystals stay alive. Authored vanilla-sized obsidian entry platform.
scenarios.startState: End obsidian platform, Phase G exit kit

scenarios.name: l-h1

commands: execute in minecraft:the_end run fill 98 48 -2 102 48 2 minecraft:obsidian
execute in minecraft:the_end run fill 98 49 -2 102 52 2 minecraft:air

scenarios.notes: Full final link includes platform escape, crystals and dragon. Real naturally generated dragon; no weakened boss, effects or artificial ammunition replenishment.
scenarios.startState: End obsidian platform, iron armour, bow/64 arrows, 64 blocks, 24 food
